name: Cloud Composer (now Managed Service for Apache Airflow)
sku: The managed Apache Airflow service documented as Cloud Composer and since renamed Managed Service for Apache Airflow. The record ID keeps the old name because IDs are immutable.

orchestrate.scheduling.note: A fully managed workflow orchestration service on Apache Airflow to create, schedule, monitor and manage pipelines that span clouds and on-premises data centres.

orchestrate.dependency-dag.note: Workflows are Airflow DAGs written in Python: collections of tasks organised to reflect their relationships and dependencies, using native Airflow tools such as the web interface and CLI.

bands.note: Each environment is a self-contained Airflow deployment on a GKE cluster with its own web server, metadata database and Cloud Storage bucket for DAGs, logs and plugins, so separate environments can be run side by side.
The Airflow web interface plus logging and monitoring of environments and DAG runs.

presentation.tagline: Managed Apache Airflow for scheduling and orchestrating pipelines.
